messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['To ensure that your service is not interrupted, please update your account information by clicking on "Log in now" below.', 'Avoid mail subscription suspension,and email retrival malfunction, by following below reference ALLOCATE MORE DATA TO [jose@monkey.org]', 'Description Unit price Qty Amount Online Number, 3 month subscription 42.98 GBP 1 42.98 GBP', 'Certificate owner must renew the certificate before expiry date.', 'If this action was made by the third person, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the sign-up information in this email, and then change the password on your account, perhaps it was stolen.', 'This email confirms your purchase of the following subscription: Name of Subscription: PREMIUM']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Keep services active by updating account details, allocating sufficient email storage, renewing certificates, and managing subscriptions, purchases, cancellations, and account security."}
